tools.name: Add Table
tools.description: Create a new table in a worksheet using the Microsoft Graph API.

inputs.name: address
inputs.about: The range address for the table. If worksheet is specified, use a range like 'A1:D4'. If worksheet is omitted, include the sheet name (e.g., 'Sheet1!A1:D4').

inputs.name: item_id
inputs.about: The ID of the Excel workbook (drive item) where the table will be created.

inputs.name: drive_id
inputs.about: Optional drive ID. Required for application-level permissions (s2s_oauth). If not provided, uses /me/drive endpoint for delegated auth. Use EXCEL_LIST_FILES or ONE_DRIVE_GET_DRIVE_ROOT to get the drive ID.

inputs.name: worksheet
inputs.about: Worksheet name or ID. When provided, the table is created on this worksheet and the address should be a range like 'A1:D4'. When omitted, the table is created at the workbook level and the address must include the sheet name prefix (e.g., 'Sheet1!A1:D4').

inputs.name: hasHeaders
inputs.about: Whether the first row of the range contains column headers (True) or not (False).

inputs.name: session_id
inputs.about: Workbook session ID controlling persistence.

tools.name: Close Excel Session
tools.description: Tool to close an existing Excel workbook session. Use when you need to explicitly end a persistent session to release workbook locks. Note: The Microsoft Graph closeSession API is idempotent - it returns 204 for both active and already-closed sessions. This action validates the session first and returns an error for invalid or already-closed sessions to provide clearer user feedback. The validation uses refreshSession which is the only API endpoint that can detect closed sessions.

inputs.about: The ID of the Excel file (drive item) to close the session for.

inputs.about: Optional drive ID. Required for application-level permissions (s2s_oauth). If not provided, uses /me/drive endpoint for delegated auth.

inputs.name: session_id
inputs.about: The workbook session ID to close. Must be a valid session ID format obtained from EXCEL_GET_SESSION.

inputs.name: session_id

tools.name: Upload Workbook from URL
tools.description: Tool to upload an external Excel file from a URL into OneDrive/SharePoint. Downloads the file server-side and uploads it to the specified drive location, returning the driveItem metadata for subsequent Excel operations.

inputs.name: drive_id
inputs.about: ID of the target drive. Use 'me' for the user's default OneDrive.

inputs.name: source_url
inputs.about: URL of the Excel file to download and upload. Must be a publicly accessible URL or authenticated URL.

inputs.name: destination_path
inputs.about: Full path including folder and filename where the file should be uploaded in OneDrive/SharePoint, e.g., 'Documents/report.xlsx'. If not provided, file will be uploaded to /Uploads/{timestamp}-{filename}.

inputs.name: conflict_behavior
inputs.about: What to do if a file already exists at the destination path. 'rename' creates a new file with a number suffix, 'replace' overwrites the existing file, 'fail' returns an error.

tools.name: Who Am I
tools.description: Return the identity (email, name) of the connected Excel (Microsoft) account.
